releases.name: Look Outside
releases.summary:
Some terrible phenomenon is taking place outside.
Those who look are changed in grotesque ways.
Something beckons you to look, too.
DO IT.

Explore the warped interior of the apartment building you are stuck in. Fight hideous monsters that were once your neighbors. Manage weapons and ammo. Play video games. Craft bombs from household supplies. Cook. Answer the door. DONT let them in.
Keep yourself alive and sane as the world just outside your window stops making sense.

Just whatever you do...
(DONT) LOOK OUTSIDE

releases.name: Distorted - Paranormal Activities
releases.summary:
A psychological horror game as paranormal investigator.

People leave traces when they go. Some leave more than that.
In Distorted – Paranormal Activities, you are commissioned to investigate an old apartment building that was quietly evacuated after a series of incidents no official report has satisfactorily explained. Your assignment is straightforward: visit each day, walk the floors, check the units, and determine whether what is happening inside is genuinely supernatural.
The building receives you with the particular stillness of a place that used to be full of life. Doormats still outside flats. A child's drawing taped to a hallway wall. Furniture left exactly as it stood on the last morning people were here.
But something lingers. A door left open that was closed. A name scratched into a wall that doesn't match any resident record. A figure standing at the far end of a corridor that isn't there when you reach it.
Each day follows the same procedure: Move through the building, observe what has changed, and trust what you remember. If something unnatural has occurred, you must place a cleansing marker in the building's old boiler room before leaving. If the day seems undisturbed, you return home and come back tomorrow.
But your judgment matters. Leave a marker on a quiet day, or leave without one when something was truly there — and the investigation starts to collapse.

releases.name: Retro Video Store Simulator
releases.summary:
Build your retro store and bring classic nostalgia back to life.

Step into a stylish 90s-inspired city and take charge of your own retro store. In this first-person business simulator, buy nostalgic products, organize your shelves, serve customers, and transform a small shop into a successful local business filled with classic media and vintage technology.

Order new stock, unpack deliveries, arrange your products, and keep your customers happy. Use your profits to expand your selection, purchase new equipment, improve your store layout, and add decorative touches that capture the authentic atmosphere of the 90s. Every improvement brings more customers, more opportunities, and a bigger business.

Key Features:
• Run Your Retro Store: Manage daily operations, serve customers, and grow your business.
• Stock Classic Products: Sell VHS tapes, video players, cameras, vinyl records, magazines, comics, and retro electronics.
• Unpack & Organize: Receive deliveries, unpack your products, and arrange them throughout your store.
• Grow Your Business: Use your profits to unlock new products, equipment, shelves, and upgrades.
• Customize Your Store: Create a unique 90s atmosphere with neon signs, posters, vintage lamps, and retro decorations.

releases.name: Goodboy Galaxy
releases.summary:
With his home world on the brink of ecological collapse, Maxwell bravely hopped into his experimental ship in dogged pursuit of a solution.

Beyond the point of no return, holding out forlorn hope, he finds himself stranded - thousands of lightyears from home, at the edge of a hostile galaxy.

Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.

Goodboy Galaxy is a game in development for Game Boy Advance, PC and Nintendo Switch. It's an exploration focused platform game similar to Metroid or Cave Story.

releases.name: Blasphemous: Martyrs' Edition
releases.summary: The Martyr’s Limited Edition includes the complete Blasphemous game with all expansions, along with a visual compendium featuring iconic artwork, a printed manual, an exclusive art print, a personal letter from the development team, and a digital code to download the full soundtrack.

releases.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
releases.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

releases.name: Pinballoid Crush
releases.summary: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

releases.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
releases.summary:
The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! 

Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break all the limits in this deceivingly simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

releases.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
releases.summary: The Cat in the Hat once said, “It is fun to have fun, but you have to know how.” Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 and Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride. Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then “Find the Cat” will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from. But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone. Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

releases.name: Asylum
releases.summary:
ASYLUM is an ambitious and intricate first-person horror adventure casting you into the hallucinatory setting of the Hanwell Mental Institute. Interact with its curious denizens, gather clues, unravel the mystery, and march towards a shocking conclusion.

With influences ranging from Lovecraft to Peter Cushing to Lucio Fulci, ASYLUM has been meticulously crafted with a strong focus on storytelling and atmosphere. Explore countless tenebrous environments, make your way through a towering, lifelike mental hospital, and solve compelling puzzles to find the answers you seek.

releases.name: Space Rock Breaker
releases.summary:
Space Rock Breaker is a short incremental experience.

Mine asteroids using weapons, process the ore using a Plinko machine, and use the rewards to increase your power.

releases.name: The Night of the Exorcism
releases.summary:
Summoned to the remote village of Southshire-Upon-Yail, you must diagnose the afflictions of a young woman that suffers a mysterious illness. Each decision you make will unveil a piece of the mystery and bring you closer to discovering the truth behind her ailments, and whatever harms her.

Will you be able to save Isabella before she is taken by her tormentors?

releases.name: Death Room: A Psychological Horror Killing Game
releases.summary:
Four girls. One locked room. Only one will survive. Will it be you?

You wake up locked in a single room with three other girls, complete strangers, forced to play a killing game none of you agreed to.

Search every corner, solve twisted puzzles, and win every macabre challenge you come across, because in this game, only one of you walks out alive.

Every girl beside you is hiding something, and figuring out who you can trust matters just as much as any puzzle.

Are you good enough to be the one who survives?


FEATURES:

● A ROOM FULL OF TWISTED PUZZLES: Every corner hides a new macabre challenge you must beat to survive.

● SHE'S ALWAYS WATCHING: The woman behind this killing game controls every rule, and she's never far.

● FOUR GIRLS, FOUR SECRETS: Tense conversations between challenges reveal who you can trust, and who's lying.

● EVERY CHALLENGE COUNTS: Losing isn't an option. Every challenge you beat keeps you in the game.

releases.name: Bella Umbrella and the mysterious garden
releases.summary:
Follow the scent, trust the wind and discover what secret awaits Bella and Neko in the heart of the garden.

Join Bella and her cat Neko on an enchanting journey through a mysterious Japanese garden full of puzzles, hidden paths and unexpected discoveries.

When Neko slips through a small opening into the garden, Bella follows him without meaning to – a sudden gust of wind catches her umbrella and carries it over the high walls. What at first seems like an ordinary garden soon turns out to be full of secrets.

Explore 300 meticulously designed levels across 30 unique regions, which together create an atmospheric journey through the garden. Discover blossoming cherry trees, tranquil ponds, winding stone paths, ancient pagodas, peaceful temples and much more. With each new region, the garden reveals new facets of its beauty. Yet at the same time, you get the impression that there is something even greater concealed behind it all.

Two characters, two different puzzles in each level

Start by playing as Neko and find your way to his beloved fish. Use his special jumps, plan each move carefully and reach the finish in a set number of moves. Explore carefully – you might even discover some hidden secrets along the way.

You will then take control of Bella. With the help of her umbrella, she lets the wind carry her through the garden. Making clever use of the wind strength and direction, fly from flower to flower and find your way to your destination. Each challenge requires logical thinking and careful planning.

On your journey, you can find and collect lots of hidden puzzle pieces. The more you discover, the more special content you’ll unlock. For curious explorers, every peek into the garden’s hidden corners is well worth it.

Enjoy the whole adventure together

In the local two-player multiplayer mode, you can either control your favourite character throughout, or swap roles after each level. Additional stats at the end of each level encourage friendly competition and invite players to compare their best solutions.

Features
• Explore a beautiful Japanese garden full of puzzles and secrets.
• Journey through 30 atmospheric regions that tell a complete story.
• Solve 300 handcrafted puzzle challenges.
• Play as the curious cat Neko and the brave Bella, who move through the garden in completely different ways.
• Keep an eye out for hidden puzzle pieces and reveal additional secrets.
• Unlock special rewards through skilful exploring.
• Play on your own or experience the whole adventure together in local multiplayer mode.
• Perfect for players of all ages: easy to learn and full of clever challenges.

releases.name: Zombie Outbreak: Last Stand Survival
releases.summary:
Complete the mission. Protect the cure. Survive the outbreak.

A deadly outbreak has turned the city into a territory of the infected. Follow the trail of Dr. Varga and Project Lazarus — humanity's last chance to stop the infection.

Fight through a full mission-based zombie survival campaign spanning 15 chapters and 29 missions. Explore ruined hospitals, contaminated sewers, abandoned farms, industrial zones, railways, underground stations and devastated city streets while uncovering the truth behind the outbreak.

releases.name: MeowPower! Yachiyo
releases.summary:
Join forces with feline friends to take down heinous humans in this fur-raising, tail-shaking, belt-scrolling action game!

Unleash your inner wild cat and claw your way to victory! Play as heroine Yachiyo and bring down baddies alongside paw-some pals!

Explore:
Venture your way through all sorts of areas—forests, mountains, and even...a FORTRESS?!

Grow:
Power up and learn new skills!

Collect:
Clobber enemies to collect junk—er, treasure!

Bonus:
Wait, there's a bonus game, too?!

releases.name: Death Room Boys: A Psychological Horror Killing Game
releases.summary:
Four guys. One locked room. Only one will survive. Will it be you?

You wake up locked in a single room with three other guys, complete strangers, forced to play a killing game none of you agreed to.

Search every corner, solve twisted puzzles, and win every macabre challenge you come across, because in this game, only one of you walks out alive.

Every guy beside you is hiding something, and figuring out who you can trust matters just as much as any puzzle.

Are you good enough to be the one who survives?


FEATURES:

● A ROOM FULL OF TWISTED PUZZLES: Every corner hides a new macabre challenge you must beat to survive.

● HE'S ALWAYS WATCHING: The man behind this killing game controls every rule, and he's never far.

● FOUR GUYS, FOUR SECRETS: Tense conversations between challenges reveal who you can trust, and who's lying.

● EVERY CHALLENGE COUNTS: Losing isn't an option. Every challenge you beat keeps you in the game.

releases.name: Sort It Out! Odd-One-Out Puzzles
releases.summary:
Spot the odd one out! Drag it to the trash bin Solve all 40 puzzles!

Four objects appear in each puzzle—but one of them doesn't belong.

Figure out what the other three have in common, spot the odd one out, and drag it into the trash bin.

The answer may seem obvious at first, but the key is figuring out how the objects are connected. Look closely, think about what links them together, and enjoy the satisfying moment when the answer clicks.

Take on 40 odd-one-out puzzles and see how many you can sort out!

releases.name: Scarlet Deer Inn
releases.summary:
Scarlet Deer Inn is a delightful story-driven exploration platformer set in the Middle Ages about facing loss and anxieties, exploring strange places, and meeting unusual characters.

You play Elise, a shy farm girl that, after losing her parents, moves with relatives who run a reputable inn. You'll take care of many activities around the inn, meet unusual travelers with their stories and explore the many sides of the busy town and its surroundings while dealing with your fears and inner demons in your sleep.

As long as you've got enough light, you'll be fine.

releases.name: Escape Game R00M18
releases.summary:
Explore 3D space and escape

Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

releases.name: Hot Spring Beauties Japanese Inn Date Memory
releases.summary:
Memorize the perfect ryokan moment! A quick photo memory challenge How many details can you remember?

Take a good look at photos set in a relaxing Japanese hot spring inn and try to remember every detail before time runs out!

From open-air baths and cozy guest rooms to elegant lounges and peaceful gardens, each scene is packed with details worth remembering.

How to play:
・Study the photo before time runs out
・Remember the people, poses, clothing, and objects around them
・Use your memory to take on the challenge

The simple gameplay makes it easy to jump in for a quick session. Enjoy the photos at your own pace while putting your memory and observation skills to the test.

Recommended for players who:
・Enjoy photo and memory games
・Like testing their observation skills
・Love Japanese inns and hot spring scenery
・Want something easy to play in short sessions
・Enjoy relaxing, glamorous photography

How much of each scene can you remember?

releases.name: For Ages 10 and Up! My First Code Logic Quiz ~ IQ Pattern Quizzes to Train Logical Thinking ~
releases.summary:
What rule is hiding in the sequence? Look closely at the puzzle and work out what should come next!

Numbers, shapes and arrangements all hold clues. This IQ pattern quiz invites you to think, compare and find the logic behind each question.

Getting started is easy!
• Study the image carefully
• Think about the hidden rule or sequence
• Choose the answer you think is correct

There is no need to memorise complicated programming code. Organising an order, finding a shared rule and predicting what comes next are all ways to enjoy logical thinking in a fun quiz format.

The key is not simply what you know, but what you notice. Take your time and enjoy that satisfying moment when the answer finally clicks.

Recommended for anyone who:
• Is curious about programming logic
• Enjoys IQ quizzes and logic puzzles
• Likes spotting patterns and sequences
• Enjoys thinking and solving problems
• Wants to tackle puzzles with family
• Would like a quick mental workout

How many patterns can you uncover? Put your intuition and logic to the test with a range of IQ pattern quizzes!

releases.name: Air Hares
releases.summary: Join the intrepid bunny pilot, Captain Rabbo, and her crew of fluffy flyers as they fight to turn the barren Winrose Warren into a blossoming landscape! Become an Air Hare in a unique take on bullet hells, restoring farmland one seed at a time, against the nefarious Gale Gang goons!

releases.name: Souls of Bombarika
releases.summary: A lone ghost battles deadly Ghost Bosses threatening humanity. Possess objects, solve reality-bending puzzles, and uncover an emotional mother-son story.
